rows.grounds: ordinal numeral qualifying vatsare; locative sense in fused temporal expression
time noun marking the stage reached in practice
past participle agreeing with vatsare; indicates attainment of the stated year
past passive participle agreeing with sā; refers to the feminine entity taken in
feminine demonstrative pronoun referring to the entity whose consumption yields the result
compound agent noun: kavitva (poetic capacity) + kṛt (maker/producer)

items.question: What poetic power arises upon reaching the twelfth year of accomplished mantra practice?
premises: The twelfth year of practice is reached.
A feminine entity is consumed in that context.
The consumed entity produces poetic capacity.
items.inference: Upon reaching the twelfth year, consuming that feminine entity brings about the power of composing poetry.
uncertainties: The specific referent of sā is not explicitly named in this verse and depends on prior context.
items.plain_english: When the twelfth year is reached, that consumed feminine entity becomes the maker of poetry.
